apps.localizedDescription:
Stermio is a modern video local that makes it easy to watch your content in one place. Import videos from the Files app or Photos, watch from links, and enjoy smooth playback in a clean, premium interface.

Built for everyday viewing, Stermio helps you organize your library, quickly reopen recent videos, and keep watching with intuitive controls.
